configurePresets.displayName: Stage 0 — Xcode generator (for debugging inside a host)
configurePresets.description: Use when you need to attach Xcode's debugger to Logic/Live and step into the editor.

configurePresets.name: stage0-lifetime
configurePresets.displayName: Stage 0 — editor-lifetime test (30 s probe delay)
configurePresets.description: Widens the probe timer so any normal open-then-close destroys the editor while the timer is pending, exercising the SafePointer guard without hand-timing a 3-second close. SEPARATE build dir on purpose: passing -DKROMOSYNTH_PROBE_DELAY_MS on the shared preset writes 30000 into the normal build's cache, and then every later log has 30-second gaps until someone remembers to reset it.

configurePresets.name: stage0-noprobe
configurePresets.description: For isolating whether a fault is ours or the framework's: if a crash reproduces with the probe gone, it is not our instrumentation.
